problem_title_a: Your company is losing money in processes
problem_subtitle: These are the 3 patterns we see when entering mid-size companies in Colombia. You'll probably recognize at least one.
problem_1_title: Broken processes no one has measured
problem_1_body: Your company has recurring operational errors. You suspect something's wrong, but you don't have the number. When we measure it, the real cost is usually 3–5× what you estimated.
problem_2_title: The team works twice as hard as needed
problem_2_body: People answering the same thing every day, generating reports by hand, double-checking data. You hired more people and the problem stayed the same: the bottleneck isn't headcount — it's process design.
problem_3_title: You already tried tech and it didn't work
problem_3_body: You bought software, hired freelancers, tried tools. Nothing stayed running because no one fixed the process before adding tech. The result: distrust toward any new proposal.
solution_subtitle: We don't sell tools. We sell process. Tech comes only after there's an ordered process to mount it on.
solution_step_1_body: We enter your operation and map how it actually works, not how the manual says. We identify the bottleneck and quantify its cost.
solution_step_2_body: We co-create the new process with your team. Only then, where it fits, we add AI on top. Never the other way around.
solution_step_3_body: We train your team to operate the system on their own. If at the end they can't run it without us, we keep working at no extra cost until they can.

faq_q1: We tried something like this and it didn't work.
faq_a1: Most AI implementations fail because they sold tech before fixing the process. We come in first to map how your company actually operates. If the process is broken, no software saves it. Tools come after.
faq_q2: AI is expensive and I'm not sure it works for my company.
faq_a2: The 30-minute diagnosis is free. Before investing a peso, you know exactly what problem you have and what it's costing you. If we don't find a problem we can solve, we'll tell you and there's no cost.
faq_q3: What if we end up depending on you to keep it running?
faq_a3: Our only success metric is that your team operates the system alone when we leave. Knowledge transfer isn't an add-on — it's part of the project. If they can't run it without us at closing, we keep working at no cost.
faq_q4: How long will this disrupt operations?
faq_a4: Plan 1 delivers a working agent in 2–4 weeks without stopping operations. Plan 2 works in parallel with the team for 6–12 weeks. The real disruption is the process-mapping sessions — 4–8 total hours from key team members.
